notes.text:
Construction reference: https://packagingprinting.co.uk/custom-boxes/luxury-rigid-boxes/two-piece-rigid-box/
Compare separate lid/base, straight walls, thin covering over board, interior lining and rim coverage; original example graphics remain independently authored.
Original image retained in this project; CASK graphics are original.

Construction reference: https://www.colorwayarts.com/blogs/blog/fabric-and-or-paper-covered-boxes-using-cartonnage-and-or-traditional-box-making
Inspect actual cloth rim, corner wrapping, visible vs concealed seams; do not copy printed fabric graphics.
Original image retained in this project; CASK graphics are original.
